methodology.approval: User requested publication of the audit recommendations on 1 November 2026.
methodology.scope: Three new cases and two additions to existing cases. Caption-matched product-content collections, including later follow-through; no inferred campaign reporting window.
methodology.attribution: Descriptions are limited to documented campaign focus and published outputs. No new personal ownership of partnership deals, budgets, sales, attendance, or production is claimed.
methodology.preservation: ACCOUNT_METRICS.json, INSTAGRAM_METRICS.json, INSTAGRAM_METRICS.csv, and the earlier CAMPAIGN_ARCHIVE.json remain unchanged.
methodology.metrics: Top-level detailed counters. Negative and missing fields are null. Shared posts appear in each relevant project and must not be added across projects.
methodology.assets: Locally stored source covers and square-cropped source previews; no generated photography. Unavailable images retain exact source links.

campaigns.title: Allegro Meta: All Game. All Day.
campaigns.description: One pair for school, basketball, and time with friends. A product campaign built around the daily routine of student-athletes.
campaigns.cover_alt: Allegro Meta basketball shoes on the orange Ready Now launch artwork
details: Project overview
Allegro Meta connects school, basketball, and everyday wear through the All Game. All Day message.
Campaign focus
A student-athlete routine: class in the morning, basketball after school, and time with friends in the same pair.
Published work
The sequence combines teasers, the July product release, everyday-use stories, 360° carousels, size guidance, store information, and creator tutorials.
Content results
The 23 linked posts span July–December 2025. Their counters include later creator content, so the figures below describe this product-content collection.

campaigns.title: Ardiles Community League × Headshoes.
campaigns.description: A basketball gathering for communities, with Headshoes at The Breeze, BSD, on 5 March 2023.
campaigns.cover_alt: Ardiles Community League and Headshoes event announcement for 5 March 2023 at The Breeze BSD
details: Project overview
Ardiles Community League with Headshoes brought basketball communities together at The Breeze, BSD, on 5 March 2023.
Event focus
A place for emerging basketball communities to play and connect, as described in the event announcement.
Published work
The five linked posts cover the announcement, a preparatory pickup game, event photography, a video recap, and participant testimonials.

campaigns.title: Spectra: Lightspeed.
campaigns.description: A speed-led product story for Spectra, bringing together launch information, product details, and creator content.
campaigns.cover_alt: Spectra White Blue and Black Purple basketball shoes on the green Ready Now campaign artwork
details: Project overview
The Lightspeed idea connects Spectra with quick movement and lightweight performance.
Published work
The October 2025 release sequence includes launch copy, colorway information, product details, and creator content, followed by additional product posts in 2026.
Content results
Seven linked posts document this product-content sequence. One creator post also features Allegro Meta.
